_comment: notifybridge example config. Deploy with config/deploy-config.ps1 (pushes to /data/local/tmp/notifybridge.json). No config file at all = bridge fully passive. Every event source is its own section (notifications/broadcasts/settings) that both listens and owns its out routes; the optional global 'routes' table matches across all sources. 'when' grammar: <type>.<action>, each side may be '*', a lone '*' = everything in scope. Unknown/extra keys are ignored; an unknown 'when' inside notifications.out is dropped with a warning.

notifications._comment: NotificationListenerService source. enabled:false (or omitting the whole section) stops notification listening entirely. calls.dialer/voip feed SIM- and messenger-call classification (ring.*/voip.* events); a plain chat message is just notify.posted/removed.

broadcasts._comment: Screen entries with polarity emit action on/off AND a real $on bit. snapshot:true re-emits the current screen state (PowerManager) into a freshly connected sink on replay.

settings._comment: Watch Settings.System.notification_light_pulse and forward changes as pulse on/off ($on = 1/0). table: system|global|secure, event: any bus event type, defaultOn: polarity when the key is missing/unreadable.
settings.name: notification_light_pulse

routes._comment: Global routes match across every source - this is the raw-tube / cross-source hook. A lone '*' mirrors everything; '*.on'/'*.off' catch every polarity event.
